answer: A farm of 52 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in wander, queued in onyx, and beacon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 31 identities per epoch. A farm of 1849 identities would post 1909 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
